headline: Paraguay Faces Political and Financial Crisis Following Ueno Bank Resolution
summary: Paraguay faces a political crisis following the resolution of Ueno Bank, which left customers unable to access accounts and sparked congressional impeachment proceedings against President Santiago Peña, leading to Pedro Alliana taking office.
why: Ueno Bank's resolution and the subsequent political fallout affect depositor security, banking sector confidence, and sovereign stability in Paraguay.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and a banking crisis negatively impact national economic confidence and sovereign risk perception.
